title: Record refunds and recover physical inventory
prerequisites: A refund-eligible owned order; separate returned goods and money evidence.

scenes.title: Find the workflow
scenes.narration: A refund records money returned, while inventory recovery records what happened to the goods. Open the order and inspect Cancellation and refunds together with Physical inventory recovery. Neither event should be assumed from the other.

scenes.title: Understand the controls
scenes.narration: Use Record manual refund only for a real refund you can support with evidence. Enter the amount and reason, and read the restock choice carefully. Partial refunds must reflect the actual money returned, not an arbitrary adjustment to the total.

scenes.title: Perform the task
scenes.narration: For goods returned after dispatch, record physical receipt first. Inspect every returned item and choose its condition. Unsafe or unsellable goods must not be made available merely because a customer was refunded.

scenes.title: Verify and continue
scenes.narration: Restock only when the recovery controls confirm eligibility and every required inspection is complete. Review payment totals, timeline and inventory history afterward. A refund, receipt, inspection and restock are distinct evidence events.
